jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Data Transformation
jobs.description:
About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

As a product-focused lead within the Data Transformation Office, you will partner with the Transformation Office leadership team to bring structure, governance, and product thinking to our API platform initiative. Drawing on your project governance background and hands-on analytics exposure, you will translate high-level business needs into a clear product roadmap, user stories, and delivery milestones. You will help shape how our APIs are designed, consumed, and evolved — turning a technical asset into a well-managed product that internal teams and clients can depend on.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Contribute to the API product vision and align the roadmap to strategic goals
Establish and maintain governance structures (intake, prioritization, change control, versioning) for the API portfolio
Create and maintain extensive documentation — including API catalogs, consumer guides, and decision logs — to enable self-service knowledge dissemination
Identify opportunities to improve processes and generate new product ideas informed by analytics and usage patterns
Work with the Product Owner and stakeholders to prioritize enhancements and manage the backlog
Anticipate, identify, manage and mitigate risks and cross-project dependencies
Manage expectations of senior management and stakeholders, facilitate steering committees, and provide regular status reports
Help to break down organizational silos and promote collaboration between business, engineering, and operations
Ensure quality of work being delivered by being involved in testing efforts, including API contract and UAT validation
Through partnership with the business, define, sponsor and steer API product initiatives
Influence and guide technology, project management, and operations teams in solution delivery
Translate light-touch data analysis (SQL, basic scripting) into product hypotheses and feature ideas
Maintain and develop expertise and keep abreast of market trends, API standards, and competitor offerings
Collaborate with other product teams on prioritization, reuse of endpoints, and shared components
Define success metrics (adoption, latency, error rates, consumer satisfaction) and use them to steer the roadmap
Work with Platform and Application teams to design API solutions in alignment with our business objectives

Qualifications

About You

5+ years hands-on experience in project/program governance, product ownership, and documentation
Working knowledge of SQL and/or basic scripting/analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Power Query, or Python fundamentals)
Experience with Power BI, Qlik, or similar reporting/visualization tools is an advantage
Collaborates effectively with individuals of varying technical ability and business acumen
Learns quickly and thrives in a fast moving, dynamic atmosphere
Strong project governance skills — intake processes, prioritization frameworks, risk/change control — with attention to detail and proven ability to multi-task
Strong knowledge of Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence)
PMP, Certified Scrum Master, or Certified Scrum Product Owner a plus
Skills in negotiation, influencing, stakeholder management
Track record of organizing and structuring technical initiatives (e.g., API programs) from a product/governance perspective
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong visual communication skills (PowerPoint, Visio, Smart Sheets)

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

jobs.title: Director, Finance
jobs.description:
About RouteThis

RouteThis is on a mission to revolutionize technical support. We build AI-powered solutions that help Internet Service Providers and Smart Home companies solve connectivity and WiFi problems before the subscriber ever needs to call.

The Role

RouteThis is 10 years in and moving from a SaaS business to an AI-native one. That shift changes the shape of the P&L, the way revenue is recognized and the questions leadership needs Finance to answer. The Director, Finance leads the function through it.

This is an FP&A-led role. The priority is planning, forecasting and cash, with Finance acting as a partner in business decisions rather than a function that reports on them afterwards. The core planning model and reporting structure are being put in place now. The Director will come in as that work lands, understand how and why it was built, and own it from there. There is still plenty to shape, including finance rhythms, spending approvals and forecasting cadence.

This role reports to the Chief Operating Officer, who leads Finance for the company and presents to the board. The Director prepares the finance materials that go to the board and leads the Financial Controller day to day. It is a hands-on role in a lean, AI-enabled team.

What You'll Do

FP&A.
Build and maintain the live weekly forecast across ARR by product line, expense and cash, and lead the annual budgeting process.
Business partnership.
Act as a thought partner to the COO and CEO, bringing forward-looking analysis into strategy and business planning before decisions are made.
Reporting and close.
Own the monthly and quarterly close, including the SaaS versus AI revenue and P&L split, and prepare board and investor materials in partnership with the COO.
Cash and treasury.
Manage runway, covenants, AR and AP, collections and foreign exchange exposure.
Team and rhythms.
Lead the Financial Controller and design the internal finance rhythms the company runs on: collections, spending approvals and forecasting cadence.
Governance.
Support audit readiness, insurance review and internal controls as the company scales.
Cross-functional partnership.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success and Professional Services on unit economics and pricing model support.
AI and tooling.
Use AI and modern finance tools to keep a small team efficient, and keep improving how the function works.

What You Bring

CPA, CA or CMA designation.
Seven or more years of progressive finance experience, with meaningful time in FP&A rather than primarily a controllership or close-focused track.
Experience in a SaaS or subscription business. Exposure to more than one revenue model, or to usage-based revenue recognition, is a strong asset.
Experience preparing board and investor materials and cash forecasts in close partnership with a CEO, COO or CFO.
Fluency building live, rolling financial models.
Comfort operating without a CFO in place and taking ownership of a newly built model and process.
A hands-on, practical approach. You are as comfortable in the detail as you are in a leadership conversation.
Comfort with AI tools and an interest in using them more.
A clear, confident communicator with the CEO, COO and board.

Why RouteThis

Ownership.
Direct visibility to the CEO, COO and board, with real ownership of the finance function.
Timing.
A 10-year-old business with a product that works, moving from SaaS to AI-native. You will see the numbers change and help lead the company through it.
Team.
A close, highly motivated team that prefers to promote from within.
Time off.
Every long weekend, the Friday is off too. The company closes for a week between Christmas and New Year.

Package

CAD $180,000 to $200,000 Competitive benefits through Manulife: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance Employee Assistance Program Equity: Stock Options 3 weeks vacation plus an additional 10 days around statutory holidays
Our downtown Kitchener office has an onsite gym and weekly team lunches. For remote team members we run other social activities.

Location

Headquartered in downtown Kitchener, Ontario, with hybrid work arrangements. Kitchener-based candidates are preferred. We will also consider strong candidates in the Toronto area who can be in Kitchener regularly.

How We Hire

We use AI tools to support our recruitment process, including helping us organize applications and identify early matches based on role criteria. That said, every rejection decision is made by a human. We encourage candidates to apply authentically and avoid relying solely on AI-generated responses, especially during interviews.

Do you feel like you're able to tackle this role? Show us what you got! We absolutely don't expect applicants to check off every box for any of our positions, and welcome you to apply if you feel like you are an excellent fit.

This opportunity is offered through HighlightTA, the on-demand talent team supporting RouteThis's growth.

RouteThis is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial or local law. Please let us know if you require an accommodation due to a disability, and RouteThis will work with you to address your needs.

Connect with us and learn more:

RouteThis on Linkedin

HighlightTA on LinkedIn

jobs.title: Vice President, Strategy & Innovation
jobs.description:
HSB Canada, part of Munich Re, is Canada's premier engineering-driven specialty insurer and provider of inspection, engineering and technology services that set the standard for excellence in the market. Our constantly evolving offerings lead the market in cyber, equipment breakdown, renewable energy, technology services, engineering based risk management and inspection services. We bring technical expertise to help our clients stay ahead of complex, emerging, and technology-based risks. We dare to think big, and we are continuously innovating on behalf of our clients. We recognize Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging as key priorities and a culture that welcomes different thoughts and opinions.

HSB is much more! It’s insurance. Engineering. Technology. To learn more about us, please visit www.hsb.ca

Primary Objectives:

HSB Canada is seeking a Vice President, Strategy & Innovation to help shape the company's long-term direction and turn strategic ambition into measurable business results. Reporting directly to the President & CEO and serving as a member of the Executive Leadership Team, this leader will bring quantitative rigor to enterprise strategy, strengthen execution discipline, and build a focused portfolio of innovation opportunities that create customer and business value.

Operating as an internal strategy and innovation consultant, the Vice President will work across business units and functions to frame complex issues, synthesize data and market insight, challenge assumptions, align senior stakeholders, and mobilize cross-functional teams. The role will also refresh HSB Canada's Internet of Things (IoT) strategy and go-to-market approach, strengthening the connection between technology-enabled services, insurance solutions, distribution opportunities, and customer needs.

The successful candidate will build strong cross-functional partnerships with HSB and Munich Re Group business leaders and enterprise partners to align priorities, remove barriers, and accelerate priorities ensuring understanding of relevant strategy, standards and philosophy.

Internal Applicants please apply online and submit your candidacy by October 14, 2026.

External Applicants please apply online and submit your candidacy by October 23,2026.

Job Responsibilities:

Enterprise Strategy and Strategic Planning
Lead enterprise strategic planning with the President & CEO and Executive Leadership Team, including strategy refreshes, scenarios, priorities, and roadmaps.
Shape evidence-based choices on growth, portfolio priorities, partnerships, investments, and emerging risks.
Translate strategy into measurable objectives, initiatives, milestones, accountabilities, and resource priorities.
Advise and challenge senior leaders, and develop clear Board materials on choices, trade-offs, progress, and decisions.
Business Performance and Execution Discipline
Co-lead quarterly business reviews with FP&A, linking strategic priorities to financial and operating performance.
Hold business leaders accountable for commitments, indicators, dependencies, corrective actions, and outcomes.
Establish practical execution disciplines, including scorecards, governance, benefits tracking, and escalation.
Use quantitative analysis to identify gaps, size opportunities, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend action, while respecting FP&A ownership of core financial processes.
Innovation Portfolio and Commercialization
Build and manage an innovation portfolio aligned with strategy, customer needs, financial goals, risk appetite, and capacity.
Identify and incubate new products, services, digital and data solutions, partnerships, and business models.
Govern opportunities from validation and business case through pilot, commercialization, and value realization.
Equip business leaders with disciplined innovation practices and recommend when to advance, pivot, pause, or stop initiatives.
IoT Strategy and Go-to-Market Leadership
Refresh HSB Canada’s IoT strategy, positioning, target segments, value propositions, ecosystem, and investment priorities.
Develop a go-to-market roadmap linking IoT-enabled risk solutions to underwriting, distribution, client needs, service delivery, and value creation.
Mobilize business, functional, and Group partners to move priority IoT opportunities from strategy to market.
Define measures for adoption, customer value, risk improvement, revenue, and profitability.
Market Insight, Executive Advisory and Group Integration
Turn customer, broker, competitor, technology, regulatory, and economic insights into actionable recommendations.
Align HSB Canada, HSB, and Munich Re Group stakeholders around shared outcomes, decisions, and timelines.
Lead high-priority cross-enterprise projects requiring structured problem solving, executive sponsorship, and coordinated execution.
Deliver Board-ready communications, represent HSB Canada in Group forums, and translate Group capabilities into Canadian opportunities.
People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop up to five professionals across strategy, innovation, market insight, and portfolio management.
Set clear priorities, delegate ownership, provide timely feedback, and hold the team accountable for results.
Build diverse talent and foster curiosity, constructive challenge, experimentation, and learning.
Influence and mobilize matrixed teams beyond direct reporting lines.

Qualifications:

Experience And Education

Approximately 12 or more years of progressive experience in enterprise strategy, corporate strategy, management consulting, innovation, business transformation, corporate development, or a related field, including significant leadership experience.
A record of advising CEOs and senior executives, leading enterprise planning, solving ambiguous business problems, and converting strategy into execution.
Experience building and governing innovation portfolios and bringing products, services, or new ventures from insight through commercialization.
Demonstrated people leadership, including coaching strong talent, setting priorities, and driving accountability across multiple concurrent workstreams.
Prior experience with a leading management consulting firm is a strong asset.
Experience in property and casualty insurance, reinsurance, or broader financial services is an asset; experience in another regulated, data-intensive sector may also be relevant.
A bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, engineering, mathematics, or a related discipline is required. An MBA or other relevant graduate degree is an asset.

Leadership Capabilities

Strategic agility: Quickly grasps complex concepts, identifies the critical question, connects disparate information, and develops clear strategic choices.
Quantitative and commercial acumen: Extrapolates insight from financial, operating, customer, and market data; builds robust business cases; and understands value drivers and trade-offs.
Executive influence: Engages confidently with the Board, CEO, Executive Leadership Team, business-unit leaders, and Group stakeholders; constructively challenges senior colleagues while building trust and alignment.
Execution orientation: Converts ideas into priorities, workplans, governance, milestones, and measurable outcomes; maintains momentum across multiple projects.
Innovation leadership: Balances curiosity and experimentation with underwriting discipline, customer value, operational feasibility, regulatory considerations, and financial return.
Communication excellence: Distils complex analysis into concise, compelling narratives and adapts communication for Board, executive, technical, and business audiences.
Enterprise mindset: Optimizes for HSB Canada as a whole, navigates a matrixed global organization, and integrates diverse perspectives without losing pace or accountability.
People leadership: Creates clarity, develops talent, fosters constructive debate, and builds a collaborative, high-performance culture.

Company Benefits:

Together, we engage with everything we have and are, to help humankind act braver and better. Go further with HSB.

We are pleased to offer our employees great benefits and resources to support their mental, physical and financial wellbeing. These include:

An engaging and collaborative environment that promotes continuous learning and development
A hybrid work environment that combines weekly in-office and remote days
A great compensation package including an annual company bonus
Competitive company-paid flexible health and dental benefits, starting on your first day
Flexible dollars provided by the company to put towards a Health Spending Account and/or Wellness Spending Account
Wellness program with tools and resources supporting your mental, physical, and financial wellbeing – on and off the job
Participation in the DC Pension Plan with a progressive employer contribution scale based on tenure starting at 4%, plus optional company match in the RRSP plan
Generous time off including vacation, personal days, unplanned time, Statutory Holidays and company-wide early closure half-days
Learning and development programs and resources, including unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, Education Assistance Program, and reimbursement for professional fees
Employee Referral Program and Recognition Program

This role is located in our Toronto office on 390 Bay St, and we operate in a hybrid work model. This job posting is for a existing vacancy.

We do not use AI in our recruitment process - applications are reviewed by our team to ensure a fair and personalized experience.

Creating and maintaining a work environment that promotes respect, diversity, and dignity is important to us. We strive for equality in our workplace, to eliminate employment barriers, and promote a workplace based on principles which align with our company values and promote positive employee practices. Candidates requiring accommodation during any stage of our selection process should advise us of this; we will strive to work with individuals to find a suitable means to meet their needs.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected for interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Associate Director,Planning
jobs.description:
Agency

Omd

Job Function

Media

Job Subfunction

Media Planning and Buying

Job Description

Strategic Planning Associate Director

The strategy team is responsible for unearthing consumer insights and behaviors to define and optimize the target audience and drive business goals for our clients. Both strategic planning and analytics are key dimensions to our work. We identify unique connection opportunities based on audience emotions and behaviors through the use of proprietary research and data and translate them into actionable insights for media, content and social marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic thinking and media fluency — Understands the broader business and marketing objectives, connects media recommendations back to them, and has enough media depth to challenge specialists and identify gaps.
Communication — Clear, concise and confident. Able to simplify complex media issues, communicate effectively with senior clients, and keep everyone aligned without overcomplicating things.
Problem solving and judgment — Can quickly assess an issue, determine what matters, identify options and recommend a path forward rather than simply escalating problems back to the client.
Proactive ownership and sense of urgency — Anticipates needs, flags risks early, moves quickly when required, closes loops and takes accountability for moving the business forward.
Attention to detail and quality control — Ensures work is accurate, client-ready, and catches errors, inconsistencies or gaps before they reach the client.
Measurement orientation — Comfortable discussing KPIs, attribution, incrementality, testing and optimization. Able to move the conversation beyond media delivery metrics into effectiveness and business outcomes.
Relationship and team leadership — Builds trust with the client and can effectively orchestrate the broader agency team, including specialists and more junior account staff.

Skills

Desired Skills & Experience

Strong analytical/logical thinking
Ability to synthesize data/research into concise action-oriented strategies
Great presentation and communication skills
Quantitative and qualitative research skills
Client relationship development and management
Deep understanding not only of how to build audiences but also a more broad understanding of different audience solutions – from building custom solutions to the different types of off the shelf solutions available
Deep understanding of data solutions (1st, 2nd and 3rd party) – how to access, use and activate
Understanding of the Digital marketing technologies, including adtech and martech solutions

Experiences

Bachelor’s degree and MBA preferable or related degree.
Background in strategy and/or consulting in digital or database marketing or communication strategy are welcome.
Demonstrated project management experience; either managing small project or small team within larger project or experience in managing deliverables/ project timeline
Experience working with large, complex data, including audience data from DMP, Acxiom, etc.
Experience working with global teams at large Fortune 2000 companies
Familiarity with different media and digital channels (e.g., TV, web, mobile, CRM, social media, search)
Familiarity with multi-channel measurement and attribution solutions
Collaborating within an agency and with extended marketing council of agencies

$75,000-$85,000

To the extent permissible by local law, Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Link to Recruitment Privacy Notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-notice/
